item.title: One of the Switch 2’s Best Exclusives Just Got a Free Demo
item.description: Get your Splattershots ready. Nintendo just released a new demo for Splatoon Raiders , the single-player-focused Splatoon spin-off that came out earlier this year. “A demo version of Splatoon Raiders is now available on Nintendo Switch 2!” reads a post from Splatoon’s X account . “Get a taste of the Spirhalite Islands with 3 different stages, and team up with Deep Cut to take 3 preselected loadouts for a test splat.”

item.title: Game of Thrones Creators' Sci-Fi Thriller Officially Returns With New Trailer
item.description: After nearly three years, Netflix's hard sci-fi series 3 Body Problem is finally returning . On Tuesday, Netflix revealed a first look at 3 Body Problem season 2 in the form of a very expensive-looking teaser trailer and a handful of new stills from the series, which herald the arrival of the destructive aliens known as the San-Ti. The cosmic war between humanity and its would-be exterminators is coming, and it looks spectacular.

item.title: Marvel Boss Officially Reveals Why Avengers Switched from Kang to Doctor Doom
item.description: Avengers: Doomsday is a month away and will find the Avengers , the New Avengers , and X-Men from the Fox films facing off against Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom . Originally, the fifth Avengers film was titled The Kang Dynasty and would have starred Jonathan Majors as Kang , who appeared in Loki and Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania . Marvel fired him in December 2023 after he was convicted on assault and harassment charges, and retooled The Kang Dynasty into the Doctor Doom-centric Doomsday .

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Designer Says Commander’s Most Divisive Staple Isn’t Going Anywhere
item.description: The two best T-shirts I saw at MagicCon: Atlanta 2026 were easy to choose in a sea of delightfully nerdy references and imagery. One was black with a wall of white text spelling out the lengthy definition of Banding, a notoriously confusing Magic: The Gathering mechanic that’s now 33 years old. The other was a white shirt featuring a picture of a Sol Ring card crossed out by a red circle and slash. “BAN SOL RING,” it read.

item.title: Lord of the Rings Returns to Theaters Next Week to Reveal an Iconic Moment
item.description: On Nov. 25, Prime Video will release the final two episodes of Lord of the Rings: Rings of Power 's third season. The penultimate episode is already confirmed to depict one of the most important moments in Middle-earth's history, the forging of the One Ring. To give that moment the respect it deserves, the episode is getting a theatrical release.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering’s New Commander Decks Offer Less for the Same Price
item.description: Magic: The Gathering players know it's an expensive hobby. Whether you're trying to keep up with a rapidly changing Standard format or you just want to add a spicy new card to your Commander deck, the hobby has surely gotten progressively more expensive. However, it's one thing to see product prices rise, and a completely different one to see that product lose some of its features while keeping the same price.

item.title: The Witcher 3 Is About to Get a Big Change to the Series’ Formula
item.description: Many phrases come to mind when thinking of The Witcher series: dark, unforgiving, morally ambiguous, Geralt in a bathtub. According to The Witcher 3 ’s new DLC Songs of the Past principal writer, Alexandra Motyka, this new chapter in Geralt's saga will add a few new adjectives to that list: “We wanted it to be paced differently from other adventures — a slow burn, sentimental, and somehow soothing.”

item.title: Star Wars Showrunner Officially Challenges Disney to Continue His Story: "I Left Them with a Baby"
item.description: If there’s one thing that has brought Star Wars fans together lately, it’s the belief that Andor was easily one of the best things to come out of the franchise for a long time. Its first season told the story of Cassian Andor, and the second focused on what led to Rogue One , where Jyn Erso, alongside Cassian, Bodhi Rook, Baze Malbus, and Chirrut Imwe, delivered those all-important Death Star plans.

item.title: The Game Awards 2026 Nominees Reveal: Here's How to Watch
item.description: The Game Awards 2026 is fast approaching, and this year's award nominees are set to be announced on Tuesday, Nov. 17. The nominees will be revealed during a dedicated livestream — that just happens to be coming two days ahead of the year's most anticipated game, Grand Theft Auto 6 .

item.title: The Hunger Games Officially Changes Genres With a Near-Perfect New Movie
item.description: More than a decade after the first film debuted, the franchise remains as relevant as ever, especially as our real world continues to look more and more like the dystopian nation of Panem. In 2023, we got a movie, The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes , exploring the backstory of the franchise’s main villain, President Snow. Francis Lawrence’s Sunrise on the Reaping , his fifth Hunger Games movie, is a direct sequel to that story, and while it’s still YA, he and his team push the boundaries of what we can expect from the genre. The result is an incredibly entertaining blockbuster with the feel of a bleak, existential horror movie.
